author: R3
objection: The exact cheap replacement is cell-scaled centered intensity, not necessarily one global k or merely an edit with the same aggregate norm. Anchor midpoint fitting contributes no initial H direction under the stated equal-variance assumptions.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: R3-C1 gives s_plus_j=4*eta*g_j*r0_j*(1-r0_j)*hat_Delta*H*x_j. Varying gates or coarse confidence across two cells makes a global k differ. Reopened Kim-Ye arXiv1904.02872v2 Section III-A Equations12-13, Chan-Vese primary PDF, GrabCut Section3.2/Figure3.
author_response: Accepted. R3 added the exact cell-specific k_j comparator with identical support, anchor gap and step; global-k is now a separate simplification ablation and midpoint changes are not a second measurement mechanism.
modification: DOSSIERS/R3.md, Round 2 author response to R4, R4-R2-A; exact control precedes more complex proposals.
remaining_disagreement: None on the replacement or collision. Actual anchor ordering/purity and image-to-anatomy validity remain unverified.

author: R3
objection: Detached one-step transfer can be a scaled implementation of direct frozen-energy training; the transfer coordinates and metric determine whether this is true. Full four-class CE is outside the controlled scalar theorem.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: For feasible s_plus=stopgrad[s0-eta*H*grad E(s0)] and H*J=J, the same-point squared-coordinate transfer gradient is eta*J^T*H*grad E=eta*grad_theta E. A logit-step target used in binary CE instead produces eta*r*(1-r)*grad_t E+O(eta^2), an additional Fisher factor.
author_response: Accepted. R3 appended the same-point equality with inverse-eta loss scaling, metric and tangent-space conditions; added CE non-equivalence; pinned origin/base/step/projection/tether/refresh; denied automatic AdamW, multi-step, or full-four-class identity.
modification: DOSSIERS/R3.md, Round 2 author response to R4, R4-R2-B. Revised control order now includes direct appearance energy on the scalar v path and detached squared-coordinate identity check before non-equivalent transfer designs.
remaining_disagreement: None. Feasible output proposals, actual neural reachability, fresh-patient quality and optimizer displacement remain separate claims.

author: R3
objection: Check whether classical appearance fitting, output descent, transfer or no-label naming are overstated relative to nearest primary work and the actual four-class task.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: Kim-Ye Eq12 already uses softmax-weighted image residuals; Eq13 estimates means from predictions. Chan-Vese is piecewise-constant region fitting. GrabCut uses user localization and alternating appearance/segmentation. R3's frozen-anchor variant changes fitting dependence, not named anatomical identification. Round1 already narrows to controlled blood-MYO updates, with BG effects and unrestricted RV/LV-odds changes outside its guarantee.
author_response: R3 explicitly retained C1-C5 only in their revised binary/controlled-path scopes, accepted the closest-prior collision and no naming/novelty inference, and preserved latent noise/purity/true-mixed-cell conditions.
modification: Round 2 appendix confirms retained scopes; no additional theorem correction required beyond the two substantive controls above.
remaining_disagreement: None within these scopes. The actual mixed-cell/anchor assumptions are unverified; there is no approved new policy or real-patient result.

author: R3
objection: Clarify that matched complete gradients can also give an identical one-step AdamW update; the caution should not imply a categorical shared-encoder or optimizer incompatibility.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: A deterministic optimizer is a function of current parameters, complete gradients, optimizer state and hyperparameters. Equal inputs give equal outputs.
author_response: Accepted and appended Round 2 precision note: exact complete gradients plus identical parameters, auxiliary losses and optimizer state/hyperparameters imply the same single AdamW update; output descent and anatomy remain separate.
modification: DOSSIERS/R3.md, Round 2 precision note — identical full gradients and one optimizer step.
remaining_disagreement: None; partial/scaled gradients or unmatched bases, metrics and histories still do not establish equality.
